apk_exact.purpose: byte-for-byte APK members; authoritative source layer

native_code.purpose: recovered/native-code inspection layer; not a replacement for apk_exact

recovery_metadata.purpose: generated manifest/index/readme material; not APK source

policy: Never overwrite exact APK members with decompiler output.
Treat recovered/decompiled files as an evidence layer and verify before implementation.
Do not infer a missing runtime API payload from static client code.
Keep actual QBank content in its own content layer.
Keep unresolved mappings unresolved instead of guessing.
